/usr/bin/bash -lc "for f in entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/pages/Hyperlink/preventDefault.ets entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/pages/Search/searchButton.ets entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/pages/Text/minMaxFontSize.ets entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/pages/TextArea/addOrDelText.ets; do printf '\\n===== %s =====\\n' \""'$f"; nl -ba "$f"; done'

/usr/bin/bash -lc "jq -r '.rules[] | select(.id? // .name? | test(\"arkui|empty|redundant|unchanged\"; \"i\"))' /rules/ruleSet.json | head -300; printf '\\n--- docs candidates ---\\n'; find /rules/docs -maxdepth 1 -type f | rg -i 'arkui|empty|redundant|unchanged|container' | sort"

/usr/bin/bash -lc "for f in entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/pages/SelectionMenuTest/bindSelectionMenuTest.ets entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/pages/index/index.ets entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/pages/EllipsisModeTest/textAreaEllipsisModeTest.ets entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/pages/EllipsisModeTest/textInputEllipsisModeTest.ets entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/pages/FontScaleTest/searchFontScaleTest.ets entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/pages/FontScaleTest/textAreaFontScaleTest.ets entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/pages/FontScaleTest/textInputFontScaleTest.ets entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/pages/HalfLeadingTest/searchHalfLeadingTest.ets entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/pages/HalfLeadingTest/textAreaHalfLeadingTest.ets entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/pages/HalfLeadingTest/textInputHalfLeadingTest.ets; do printf '\\n===== %s =====\\n' \""'$f"; nl -ba "$f" | sed -n '"'16,125p'; done"

/usr/bin/bash -lc "for f in entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/pages/Hyperlink/preventDefault.ets entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/pages/Search/searchButton.ets entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/pages/Text/minMaxFontSize.ets entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/pages/TextArea/addOrDelText.ets; do printf '\\n===== %s =====\\n' \""'$f"; nl -ba "$f" | sed -n '"'16,48p'; done"

/usr/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' /rules/package.json; printf '\\n--- root run files ---\\n'; sed -n '1,240p' /rules/lib/run.js; printf '\\n--- rule config ---\\n'; sed -n '1,140p' /rules/ruleSet.json"

/usr/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"@State\" entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/pages/{Hyperlink/preventDefault.ets,Search/searchButton.ets,Text/minMaxFontSize.ets,TextArea/addOrDelText.ets,FontScaleTest/searchFontScaleTest.ets,HalfLeadingTest/searchHalfLeadingTest.ets}; printf '\\nlisted container constructors:\\n'; rg -n \"Row\\(\\)|Column\\(\\{? ?space|Column\\(\\)\" entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/pages/{EllipsisModeTest,FontScaleTest,HalfLeadingTest}/*.ets | head -80; printf '\\nempty listener patterns:\\n'; rg -n -U \"onTextSelectionChange\\(["'^'"\\n]*\\)\\s*\\{\\s*\\}\" entry/src/main/ets/MainAbility/pages/SelectionMenuTest/bindSelectionMenuTest.ets || true"

/usr/bin/bash -lc "jq -e 'type == \"object\" and (.selected_rules|type==\"array\") and (.entity_repairs|type==\"array\") and (.blocked|length==0) and (.unresolved_external|length==0) and all(.entity_repairs[]; .evidence|type==\"array\" and length>0 and (.status==\"repaired\"))' .exp_agent/round_01/completion.json && echo completion-structurally-valid"

/usr/bin/bash -lc "jq -e 'type == \"object\" and (.selected_rules|type==\"array\") and (.entity_repairs|type==\"array\") and (.blocked|length==0) and (.unresolved_external|length==0) and all(.entity_repairs[]; ((.evidence|type)==\"array\" and (.evidence|length)>0 and .status==\"repaired\"))' .exp_agent/round_01/completion.json && echo completion-structurally-valid"

/usr/bin/bash -lc "git -C /workspace status --short 2>&1 || true; jq '[.rules[].files[].locations[]] | length' .exp_agent/round_01/plan.json; jq '[.entity_repairs[].locations[]] | length' .exp_agent/round_01/completion.json"
